title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.19: Fixed Limited/Unlimited losing a stack for a turn they never took effect. Stacks granted at the start of your turn by Punished land after the cards are drawn, so they were being ticked down for a turn on which they did nothing — Punished 13 now really gives you 13.
